verdict.rationale: An in-browser toolbar is a fair question for a deploy and hosting platform, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack never documents one for feedback, feature flags or performance inspection on a live site. The nearest items are adjacent features that do not deliver the story: shareable preview URLs and collaborative preview environments (netlify-docs-19, netlify-docs-27) and dashboard-side performance tracking per deployment (netlify-docs-17).

support.subject: As a developer, I can use an in-browser toolbar to leave feedback, manage feature flags, and inspect performance directly on my live site
